prompt: Create a minimalist clean flat vector portrait of a young woman shown from the chest up, centered on a square canvas. She has long straight dark brown-black hair with soft wispy bangs and loose shoulder-length layers, warm light-medium skin, delicate facial features, almond-shaped open eyes looking calmly forward, subtle eyeliner, natural lips, and a soft closed-mouth smile. She wears thin black-rimmed round glasses and an oversized plain black crewneck sweatshirt. Pose her with one hand gently resting against her cheek near the glasses frame, elbow implied below the crop, relaxed and thoughtful. Use a modern digital vector illustration style with smooth simplified shapes, crisp dark outlines, painterly cel-shaded shadows, warm orange highlights on skin and hair, detailed but stylized hair strands, and no visible texture or text. Set the portrait against a solid dark warm brown background, with soft frontal lighting, high contrast between the black clothing and warm face, clean edges, no accessories besides the glasses, no watermark, no border.

promptZh: 创作一张极简主义的扁平化矢量插画肖像，主角为 一位年轻女性，留着 微卷的深棕黑色长发，配有随意的刘海，佩戴着 细黑框圆眼镜，身穿一件超大号的 纯黑色卫衣。画面展示其胸部以上部位，居中构图，正脸朝向前方，头部略微倾斜，双眼睁开并平静地注视着观众，嘴角带着柔和的微笑。一只手轻轻托在靠近眼镜框的脸颊旁，手肘位于画面外。采用暖棕色肤色、简洁的矢量形状、细腻的绘画感渐变、清晰的深色轮廓线、简化的面部特征、发丝上的精致高光以及衣物上柔和的阴影块。肖像背景为简单的纯色 深暖棕色，无文字、无道具、无水印，且不含照片级真实纹理。方形画布，紧凑的社交媒体头像构图，精致的编辑级矢量艺术风格。
